raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 was partly re-delivered at 2026-01-18 22:00 with changed amounts for 21 txn_ids, so raw_transactions holds two versions of those transactions and silver_transactions keeps both. The later ingest_ts copy looks like a restatement, so silver should keep only the latest version of each txn_id before applying the POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
